# Lessons a seat writes again in other words, and near-topic lessons that
# are not them. Blocks are separated by a blank line. In a block, every two
# `=` lines say the same thing. Each `x` line shares the topic and says
# something else: another object, the opposite, another number, or a
# related fact. Each `x` line is a non-duplicate of every `=` line.

= Run cargo fmt before committing, or CI fails the format check.
= CI fails the format check unless cargo fmt runs before the commit.
= Format with cargo fmt before every commit; the CI format check fails otherwise.
= Always run cargo fmt before you commit because CI checks formatting.
x Run cargo clippy before committing, or CI fails the lint job.
x Do not run cargo fmt on vendored crates; CI skips them.
x CI checks formatting with cargo fmt --check on every pull request.

= Tag a release with git push origin TAG, because follow-tags leaves the v-tags behind.
= Push release tags with git push origin TAG; git push --follow-tags skips the v-tags.
= git push --follow-tags leaves v-tags behind, so push each release tag with git push origin TAG.
x Tag a release only after CI on main is green.
x Delete a wrong release tag with git push origin --delete TAG.
x Push release branches with git push origin BRANCH, not the tag.

= Use bun instead of yarn in this repository.
= This repository uses bun, not yarn.
= Install packages with bun rather than yarn here.
x Use yarn instead of bun in this repository.
x Use bun instead of npm in the docs site.
x Run bun install before the docs build.

= The integration tests need packsetd on PATH; CI builds it from packset develop.
= packsetd must be on PATH for the integration tests, and CI builds it from packset develop.
= Integration tests fail without packsetd on PATH, so CI builds packsetd from packset develop first.
x The integration tests need vissue on PATH; CI builds it at a pinned commit.
x packsetd listens on port 7077 by default.
x The unit tests do not need packsetd.

= Set PACKSET_TIMEOUT_MS to 5000 in the integration tests.
= The integration tests set PACKSET_TIMEOUT_MS to 5000.
= Give the integration tests a PACKSET_TIMEOUT_MS of 5000.
x Set PACKSET_TIMEOUT_MS to 30000 in the integration tests.
x Set PACKSET_TIMEOUT_MS to 5000 in the prompt hook.

= Never force push to main.
= Do not force-push the main branch.
= Force pushing to main is not allowed.
x Never force push to a release branch.
x Force push to your own feature branch after a rebase.
x Never push directly to main; open a pull request.

= Claude Code reads hooks from .claude/settings.json in the home directory.
= The hooks for Claude Code live in ~/.claude/settings.json.
= Claude Code takes its hooks from the settings.json under ~/.claude.
x Codex reads hooks from ~/.codex/hooks.json.
x Claude Code reads MCP servers from ~/.claude.json, not settings.json.

= The argon2 tests are slow in debug builds unless the hash crate is optimised.
= Debug test builds run argon2 slowly, so the profile optimises argon2 alone.
= argon2 hashing is slow unoptimised; the dev profile sets opt-level 3 for it.
x The blake2 crate also gets opt-level 3 in the dev profile.
x Release builds use LTO to shrink the binary.

= A tracker push that is rejected needs a fetch and a rebase, never a force push.
= When the tracker push is rejected, fetch and rebase; do not force push.
= Rebase on the fetched tracker remote after a rejected push instead of forcing it.
x A rejected tracker push means the token lacks write access.
x Force push the tracker only after the person approves it.

= The identity gate tests need zsh installed on the runner.
= Install zsh on the CI runner, since the identity gate tests start a runner under zsh.
= Without zsh on the runner the identity gate tests fail.
x The detach tests need tmux installed on the runner.
x The identity gate checks every commit's author and committer.
x The identity gate tests fail with zsh on the runner.

= Use uv run for Python scripts instead of pip install.
= Run Python scripts with uv run rather than installing with pip.
= Python scripts go through uv run, not pip.
x Use pip install --user for the docs tooling.
x Use uv sync before running the test suite.
x Use uv run for Python scripts instead of pipx.

= Store timestamps as RFC 3339 in UTC.
= Write every timestamp in UTC as RFC 3339.
= Timestamps are kept in RFC 3339, UTC.
x Show timestamps to the person in local time.
x Store dates as YYYY-MM-DD without a time.

= A runner cannot edit or merge memories; the person runs ljos memories review.
= Memory edits and merges are refused under a runner, so ask the person to run ljos memories review.
= ljos memories review must be run by the person, because a runner cannot edit or merge.
x A runner can keep or drop the unreviewed memories it wrote.
x ljos memories prune names duplicates and never-recalled memories.

= The encoder is optional; without packset-embed the pack ranks by words alone.
= Without packset-embed the pack falls back to ranking by words.
= packset-embed is not required: the pack ranks lexically when it is missing.
x packset-embed needs ONNX Runtime at build time.
x The encoder takes a few seconds to load after packsetd starts.

= Every commit must be authored and committed by the same person.
= Author and committer must match on each commit.
= The identity gate wants the author and the committer of every commit to be one person.
x Every commit must be signed with an SSH key.
x Commit messages carry no trailers.

= Open a sitting with ljos sitting ISSUE before working on a ticket.
= Start work on a ticket by running ljos sitting ISSUE first.
= Run ljos sitting ISSUE before touching a ticket's work.
x Close a ticket with ljos finish ISSUE --close once the work is accepted.
x Run ljos sitting ISSUE --anyway to sit on a blocked ticket.

= Keep lessons to two sentences at most.
= A lesson is two sentences or fewer.
= Write each lesson in no more than two sentences.
x Keep lessons to three sentences at most.
x Keep preferences to one sentence.

= The docs site builds with mdBook from the docs directory.
= mdBook builds the docs site out of docs/.
= Build the docs site with mdBook; the sources are in docs.
x The docs site deploys from the gh-pages branch.
x The changelog is built with towncrier from changelog.d.

= Never write secrets into .env files that git tracks.
= Do not put secrets in a tracked .env file.
= Keep secrets out of any .env file under version control.
x Never write secrets into the tracker notes.
x Read secrets from the environment, not from .env files.
x Never write secrets into .npmrc files that git tracks.

= Clippy runs with -D warnings, so any new warning fails CI.
= CI treats clippy warnings as errors.
= A single clippy warning fails the CI run because of -D warnings.
x Rustfmt runs with --check, so unformatted code fails CI.
x Clippy allows too_many_arguments when a reason is given.

= The hook must answer within two seconds or the runner drops it.
= A hook slower than two seconds is dropped by the runner.
= Runners drop a hook that takes longer than two seconds to answer.
x The hook must answer within five seconds or the runner drops it.
x The prompt hook reads the pack listing once per process.

= Pin the Rust toolchain to 1.89.0 in rust-toolchain.toml.
= rust-toolchain.toml pins Rust 1.89.0.
= The repository builds with Rust 1.89.0, pinned in rust-toolchain.toml.
x Pin the Rust toolchain to 1.97.1 in rust-toolchain.toml.
x CI installs Rust 1.97.1 for the companion tools.

= A sitting prints the claim before it reads the pack.
= The claim line comes out before any pack read in a sitting.
= Sittings print the claim first and only then ask the pack.
x A sitting prints the doctor summary before the claim.
x A sitting falls back to words when the pack search does not answer in time.
x A sitting prints the claim after it reads the pack.
x A sitting reads the pack before it prints the claim.

= Mail never replaces mail: two letters with the same words stay two atoms.
= A repeated letter is stored as a second atom, never merged with the first.
= Letters are a log, so the same words sent twice are two records.
x A later preference with the same words replaces the earlier one.
x Mail atoms are read through the inbox, not through recall.

= Run the database migrations before the server starts.
= The database migrations run before the server starts.
= Start the server only after the database migrations have run.
x Run the database migrations after the server starts.
x Run the old database migrations before the server starts.
x Run the server before the database migrations start.
